name: measurement-availability
goal: A metric that could not be measured is stated as unavailable or partial with the reason, never as a measured zero; baselines record it and the gate, the index and the console treat it as such

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Independent observation: harness budget measure reported complexity 0 points for kernel.impact-kernel, whose source is Rust, and a staging record stored that zero; its dependency count 1 was presented as complete although neither its Rust nor the crates its Cargo.toml declares are read. Boundary found: decision points and references are read in TypeScript, JavaScript and Svelte (references also in stylesheets); every other file got one block with complexity 0 and no references, and an unread file got size 0. Expected: no value and a reason, or a value with a note of what it leaves out; a counted zero stays zero.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/measure-availability.e2e.test.ts on the unchanged code: 2 failed (work/logs/stage-f-measure-availability-red.log: expected value null for a Rust crate, received 0; the ledger froze complexity 0). Dependency scope: stage-f-dependency-scope-red-2.log, 2 failed (dependencies 0 unqualified for a crate with a declared package; ledger froze 0) while the complexity tests stayed green.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Each file is classified as counted, declarative or unsupported and as read or not (complexityCoverage, SourceIndexService). unitMeasurements gives no value with a reason when nothing is counted or read, and a value with a partial note otherwise, for complexity, size and the dependency count. A baseline records a frozen metric without a value as unmeasured with the reason; the gate states it as unavailable only then, refuses a number that became unavailable and requires a reviewed limit once it is measurable. budget measure and status, the history index growth notes, the component panel and the growth table show it.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same commands, tests as listed in work/logs/stage-f-test-diff.log: test/measure-availability.e2e.test.ts 2 passed and test/measure-dependencies.e2e.test.ts 2 passed (stage-f-dependency-scope-green-1.log and the full check), with unit tests in test/utils/measure-availability.test.ts, growth-notes.test.ts and packages/reports/test/utils/harness-budget.test.ts. On this repository: kernel.impact-kernel complexity unavailable with the Rust reason, dependencies 1 marked partial naming the Rust files and Cargo.toml; three Python script units unavailable.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full bun run check exit 0 (work/logs/stage-f-check-3.log). Browser: harness-measured.spec.ts 2 passed; the console scenario captures the unavailable, partial and unavailable-growth states at 1440, 920 and 390 and its contract check passes (stage-f-measured-scenario-2.log, 7 passed; complete suite 114 passed). Captures inspected: work/stage-f/captures/console-scenario/unavailable-mobile.png, partial-tablet.png, unavailable-growth-mobile.png.
